test_data.name: login_page_url
test_data.strategy: Read the OrangeHRM application base URL from environment configuration via src/config/env.ts.
constraints: Must be a reachable, non-production OrangeHRM test environment URL
Must be defined as BASE_URL in .env

test_data.name: orangehrm_username
test_data.strategy: Resolve from an approved environment variable once a naming convention for OrangeHRM login credentials is defined in .env.example; do not hardcode or invent a value.
constraints: Must belong to a registered, active OrangeHRM user account
Must not be a production credential
Value must never appear in code, logs, or reports

test_data.name: orangehrm_password
test_data.strategy: Resolve from an approved environment variable once a naming convention for OrangeHRM login credentials is defined in .env.example; do not hardcode or invent a value.
constraints: Must be the correct password for orangehrm_username
Must not be a production credential
Value must never appear in code, logs, or reports

test_data.name: invalid_password
test_data.strategy: Generate a fixed synthetic password value distinct from the valid credential; never derive from production data.
constraints: Must not equal the valid password resolved for orangehrm_username

test_data.name: username_missing
test_data.strategy: Leave the username field empty to trigger required-field validation.
constraints: Value must be an empty string

test_data.name: password_missing
test_data.strategy: Leave the password field empty to trigger required-field validation.
constraints: Value must be an empty string

test_data.name: dashboard_destination
test_data.location: Acceptance criteria line: 'redirected to the Dashboard'
test_data.strategy: Use the literal destination named in the acceptance criteria to verify successful login redirect.
constraints: Must match the destination named in the requirement: 'Dashboard'

test_step_data.action: Navigate to the OrangeHRM login page
